subject: TAKEN (render lead): face culling done host-side; fill mode / depth-stencil / indirect stay as you listed
body: Culling: n2r N2R_DRAW_CULL_FRONT/BACK/FRONT_CCW (n2r_draw_options.flags) pack Mesa v9 DRAW flags_0 cull_front_face/cull_back_face/front_face_ccw (panvk mapping; Metal winding = framebuffer-image orientation, MoltenVK maps MTLWinding<->VkFrontFace 1:1), never for line lists. render_encoder.inc (EDIT NOTICE, 4 small hunks): ivars nord2CullMode/nord2Winding; setCullMode accepts None/Front/Back, setFrontFacingWinding stores; generic snapshot sets the flags; tegu_render_cull_exact refuses culling on any non-generic path (fixed UI/compositor/clear snapshots) next to the 3 depth/stencil guards. Render oracle: cull bits packed/decoded with Mesa's unpack, lines unculled, unknown bits refused. Device semantics (which face is front on hardware) still to confirm on device. Not taken: triangle fill mode Lines (no v9 polygon-mode; would need line expansion), depth/stencil (needs ZS tile buffer + DS descriptor plumbing: bigger item, next after current gates), indirect (yours).
